checklist_results.name: Conclusions vs Original Results
checklist_results.rationale: All 8 major claims in the documentation are explicitly supported by specific tables/figures. Each conclusion references quantitative results: Table 2 (main FV performance), Figure 2 (layer sweep), Table 3 (portability), Table 4 (vocabulary reconstruction), Table 5 (vector algebra), Figure 3 (causal mediation), Table 6 (multi-model scaling), Table 7 (natural text). No unsupported claims were identified.

checklist_results.name: Implementation Follows the Plan
checklist_results.rationale: All 8 methodology steps from the plan are fully implemented in the codebase. Specifically: (1) Causal mediation analysis is implemented in compute_indirect_effect.py with systematic sweeps over attention heads; (2) FV extraction via head summation is in extract_utils.py; (3) Multi-model support includes GPT-J, GPT-NeoX, Llama-2-7b/13b/70b with universal head sets; (4) Layer intervention via TraceDict hooks; (5) Shuffled-label/zero-shot/natural text evaluation modes; (6) Vocabulary reconstruction in vocab_reconstruction.py; (7) Vector algebra supported through standard tensor operations; (8) Portability across 120 template combinations in portability_eval.py. All 6 planned experiments have corresponding implementations with matching metrics.

checklist_results.name: Effect Size
checklist_results.rationale: All reported effects have substantial, non-trivial magnitude. The main FV result shows 51.7 percentage point gain on shuffled-label (90.8% vs 39.1% baseline, >2x improvement) and 52.0 percentage point gain on zero-shot (57.5% vs 5.5% baseline, ~10x improvement). Effects scale across models: Llama 2 70B achieves 93.0% shuffled-label and 74.2% zero-shot. Natural text evaluation shows ~59 percentage point gain over baselines. The vocabulary reconstruction gap (25.1 pp) supports the hypothesis that FVs encode more than output vocabulary. All 7 examined effects exceed 20 percentage points absolute gain, well above minimal meaningful thresholds.
checklist_results.evidence_summary: 7/7 effects non-trivial, all exceed 20pp absolute gain

checklist_results.name: Justification
checklist_results.rationale: All major design choices and conclusions are explicitly justified. Key hyperparameters justified: (1) EDIT_LAYER=9 derived from layer sweep experiments (Figure 2), (2) n_top_heads=10 based on AIE ranking and ablation studies, (3) N_TRIALS=100/25 standard practice for variance reduction. Task and model selection justified by diversity requirements and generality testing. Universal head sets computed via task-averaged AIE with scores provided. Filtering strategy justified as isolating task triggering from task learning. All 5 major conclusions reference specific experimental evidence. Notably, vector algebra results present nuanced conclusions acknowledging both successes and failures.

checklist_results.name: Statistical Significance
checklist_results.rationale: All major results include appropriate uncertainty estimates. The documentation reports standard deviations across 5 random seeds for main results (e.g., 90.8% ± 0.9% for shuffled-label, 57.5% ± 1.7% for zero-shot). Cross-model results include standard deviations. Portability evaluation aggregates across 20+ templates showing variance. Vocabulary reconstruction reports std across seeds and KL divergence values. Natural text results report ranges across templates (55-68% vs 0-3%). The implementation supports statistical rigor: N_TRIALS=100 for activations, n_seeds=5 for experiments, proper random state management via set_seed(). Validation/test split separation ensures unbiased filtering.
checklist_results.evidence_summary: 7/7 results with uncertainty, 4/4 statistical infrastructure elements

strengths: Complete alignment between plan methodology and implementation code
All conclusions backed by specific quantitative evidence (tables/figures)
Effect sizes are substantial (>20pp gains across all major results)
Transparent justification of hyperparameters through ablation studies
areas_of_note: Vector algebra composition shows mixed results (acknowledged in documentation)
Some experiments require significant compute (70B model evaluation)
